# dsh-bird-bike 🐦🚲
English | 简体中文
A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of
the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web GUI.
## Features

- 🐦 **Pixel chicken rider**: IK-pedaled legs, two-frame wing flaps, blinking eyes, teal helmet
- 🚲 *

*Pixel bicycle**: spoked wheels, chainring, pedal cranks
- 🌙 **Day/night cycle**: ~80 seconds per da
y, dusk/dawn in eight quantized color steps; starry sky, square moon, and a headlight beam at night
- 👾 **Mobs**: creepers roam by day — entering the 2m trigger range starts the fuse (accelerating fla
sh), and the blast launches the chicken into a forced super jump (no penalty); zombies shamble towar

d the rider at night and are knocked flying on contact (tumble + spin)
- 🔔 **Bell**: chip-tune ding

+ Minecraft-style colorful note particles + a short boost (dust)
- 🦘 **Jump**: chunky hop with landi

ng dust
- ⏱ **Ride stats**: distance / speed / riding time (accumulates only while actually riding)

in fixed-width tabular slots — no layout jitter
- ▾ **Collapsible**: the strip folds into a 40px min

i rail; the choice persists locally
- ♿ Honors `prefers-reduced-motion`: still world, interactions s

choice persists locally
- ♿ Honors `prefers-reduced-motion`: still world, interactions still animate
## Install
### Option 1: official CLI (recommended)

Plain JavaScript with no build step and no prepare script, so the install never triggers a pnpm allo
t with no build step and no prepare script, so the install never triggers a pnpm allowBuilds prompt.
### Option 2: DSH plugin manager

1. Open the DSH web GUI → **Plugins** in the sidebar
2. **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plu

gin**
3. Paste the repository URL `https://github.com/blackstar-baba/dsh-bird-bike` and confirm — th
e strip appears at the bottom of the app frame
### Option 3: manual link to a local clone
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then enable `dsh-bird-bike` on the **Plugins** page (or add `"dsh-bird-bike"` to `dsh.profile.bundle
s` in the profile `package.json`).
## Controls
| Action | Effect |

| Click the strip | Bell + note particles + boost |
| 🔔 | Ring the bell |
| 🦘 | Jump |
| 🌙 / ☀️ | Ju

mp to the other phase |
| ▾ / ▴ | Collapse / expand the strip |
## How it works
- Plain JavaScript, zero dependencies, no build step: a single `client.js` registers a lazy factory

via `window.__ModuleLoader__` and mounts into ui-layout's `shell.bottom` slot
- The whole scene rend
ers on a low-resolution offscreen canvas (1 art pixel = P CSS pixels) with hard-edged pixel primitiv

es (rects / Bresenham lines / scanline ellipses), then upscaled nearest-neighbor
- Chrome colors use
`--dsw-*` theme tokens; the artwork palette is its own by design (artwork exception)
## Uninstall
Remove it from the **Plugins** page, or `pnpm remove dsh-bird-bike` inside the profile directory and
drop it from `dsh.profile.bundles`.
## Compatibility
Requires **DSH >= 0.2.1-alpha** (the `shell.bottom` slot the strip mounts into shipped in that relea
ires **DSH >= 0.2.1-alpha** (the `shell.bottom` slot the strip mounts into shipped in that release).
Developed on a DSH source checkout, `web` profile (`dsh.client` platform: web, manifest declares `ds
h.bundle`). No npm dependencies — only Client baseline builtins (react, slots).
